content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

Using GitHub Pages for hosting your digital product store provides a sovereign solution for creators in regions where mainstream payment platforms fail to operate. GitHub Pages allows you to host your website at no cost, while enabling automatic delivery of products through backend scripts. This setup ensures that you retain full control over your sales and customer data, a crucial aspect in today’s digital economy where ownership is key. By opting for this infrastructure, you avoid the high fees associated with conventional platforms like Gumroad, which charges up to 10% per sale, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

GitHub Pages serves as the front end of your digital store, providing a reliable and free hosting solution. The backend logic can be powered by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which handle the automation of product delivery and payment verification. When a customer purchases a product, NOWPayments processes the transaction in over 300 cryptocurrencies, charging only a 0.5% fee. This architecture not only enhances your revenue retention but also ensures that your store operates smoothly without the dependence on third-party platforms. The combination of these tools creates a robust framework that supports real-time cryptocurrency payments and instant product delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where traditional payment processors are either inaccessible or costly. If you sell digital products such as templates, ebooks, or software, this setup provides a straightforward and cost-effective solution. By eliminating platform fees, you can focus on scaling your business without the stress of hidden costs that eat into your profits. This approach empowers you not only to sell your products but also to build a sustainable income stream using the tools available today.
GitHub Pages provides a free and robust hosting solution for your digital store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture comprises several key components: GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend automation, NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, and a cloud service like Google Drive for file delivery. Each element plays a vital role in creating a seamless experience for both you and your customers. Together, they form a sovereign stack that allows creators to operate independently, with no reliance on external platforms. This ensures that you can scale your store as needed, retain full ownership, and serve your customers efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your store. Next, upload your product files and create a simple HTML page to present your offerings. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate product delivery when a transaction is confirmed. Integrate NOWPayments for processing payments and specify your cryptocurrency options. Finally, test your store to confirm that everything works smoothly before promoting it. With these steps, you can launch your digital product store and begin selling immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
NOWPayments enables you to accept cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, maximizing your profit.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your digital store. 2. Upload your digital product files to the repository. 3. Create an HTML page that lists your products and includes purchase buttons. 4. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate delivery after payment confirmation. 5. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. 6. Test the entire process to ensure seamless customer experience. 7. Promote your store to start generating sales.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by setting up a digital store using GitHub Pages. Pair it with NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, which allows you to accept payments without relying on PayPal or Stripe.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is by using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup significantly reduces costs compared to platforms that charge high fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by establishing your own online store with GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for my digital store?
Using NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee of 0.5%. This means you retain more of your revenue compared to traditional payment processors.
Is there any ongoing cost to maintain my GitHub Pages store?
No, GitHub Pages is free to use for hosting your store. The only cost you incur is the 0.5% fee from NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions.
